claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 streams live at 6 PM ET/3 PM PT.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on the ESPN App with ESPN Unlimited in the U.S.
WrestleMania 42 streams live on Netflix internationally.
WrestleMania 42 is a two-night event from Las Vegas.
U.S. streaming of WrestleMania 42 is exclusive to the ESPN App via an ESPN Unlimited subscription.
International streaming of WrestleMania 42 is on Netflix.
WrestleMania 42 is available through cable/satellite providers including DIRECTV, FuboTV, Hulu + Live TV, Spectrum, Verizon Fios, and Cox.
Start time for WrestleMania 42 is 6 PM ET / 3 PM PT on both nights.
Undisputed WWE Championship match at WrestleMania 42 is Cody Rhodes (c) vs. Randy Orton.
Women’s World Championship match at WrestleMania 42 is Stephanie Vaquer (c) vs. Liv Morgan.
Unsanctioned Match at WrestleMania 42 is Jacob Fatu vs. Drew McIntyre.
Singles Match at WrestleMania 42 is Seth Rollins vs. Gunther.
FuboTV includes the first hour of each night of WrestleMania 42 on ESPN2.
FuboTV provides full access to WrestleMania 42 via ESPN app credentials.
Highlights of WrestleMania 42 are available on the official WWE channel on YouTube.
